//: Story Phase 16: the counter's customers arrive out of the haze at the end of the barricade, are served, and go.
p16.counter.disp_wheezeworth.intro: disp_wheezeworth: (out of the haze, wheezing) One jar of the green, please. The MELLOW one. My doctor says I'm too tense. My doctor's been dead two hundred years. He's still tense.
p16.counter.disp_wheezeworth.after: From his pad in the lounge, without opening his eyes, Brogath lets go of one small, mellow, green one. You catch it in a jar. You screw the lid on. You hand it over the counter.
disp_wheezeworth: (unscrewing the lid a crack, sniffing, going limp) Ohhh. Oh, that's the one. (dissolving, happily)
p16.counter.disp_mildew.intro: disp_mildew: (very elegant) A small jar. For the boudoir. Do you gift-wrap?
disp_mildew: (unbothered) Then I'll carry it NAKED.
p16.counter.disp_mildew.after: From his pad in the lounge, without opening his eyes, Brogath lets go of one small, mellow, green one. You catch it in a jar. You screw the lid on. You hand it over the counter.
disp_mildew: (holding the jar up to the lantern) It's green. How DARING.
p16.counter.disp_stalebreath.intro: disp_stalebreath: Large jar. Extra large. Is there a loyalty card? There should be a loyalty card.
garrick: (from somewhere, delighted) THERE COULD BE A LOYALTY CARD.
p16.counter.disp_stalebreath.after: From his pad in the lounge, without opening his eyes, Brogath lets go of one small, mellow, green one. You catch it in a jar. You screw the lid on. You hand it over the counter.
disp_stalebreath: (holding it with both arms) I'll be back. I'll be back for the rest of eternity, at this rate.
p16.counter.disp_draftly.intro: disp_draftly: (both of them, at once) Two jars. One each. Not the same jar. We've done the same jar. Never again.
p16.counter.disp_draftly.after: From his pad in the lounge, without opening his eyes, Brogath lets go of one small, mellow, green one. You catch it in a jar. You screw the lid on. You hand it over the counter.
disp_draftly: (both, sniffing, both going cross-eyed at once) ...Oh, that's NICE.
p16.counter.disp_fumble.intro: disp_fumble: (dropping all his tokens on the floor, picking them up, dropping them again) Sorry. Sorry. Just a little jar. The littlest jar. Is it the littlest? Sorry.
p16.counter.disp_fumble.after: From his pad in the lounge, without opening his eyes, Brogath lets go of one small, mellow, green one. You catch it in a jar. You screw the lid on. You hand it over the counter.
disp_fumble: (dropping the jar; it bounces; it's fine) SORRY. (it's fine) ...It's fine! Oh, I feel fine.
p16.counter.bankworth_deposit.intro: bankworth: (at the window, formally) An opening deposit, Teller. Into the Grand Bank. Which is to say: me. It would be terribly bad form for a bank to open without one.
p16.counter.bankworth_deposit.after: bankworth: (straightening his vault-door crown) Splendid. Solvent! We are OPEN.
p16.counter.credit_rottingham.intro: credit_rottingham: (slapping a sash on the counter that clanks) GRAND SASHBACK REWARDS. I'll have the BLACK card. Whatever's blacker than black.
captain[tired]: (holding the sash at arm's length) I have to smell it, sir. That's the... that's the procedure.
credit_rottingham: (proudly) Go on. It's been through three wars and a bean festival.
p16.counter.credit_rottingham.after: credit_rottingham: (taking his card) Three wars, I said. THREE.
p16.counter.credit_mustyhem.intro: credit_mustyhem: (tiny, apologetic) I'm not sure my sash qualifies, dear. I wash it. Every Sunday. Is that... bad?
bankworth: (very gently, from behind you) It is a challenging profile, madam. The teller will do his best.
p16.counter.credit_mustyhem.after: credit_mustyhem: (pleased anyway) Oh, I've never had a card before. Can I lick it?
p16.counter.rancidella.intro: rancidella: (sweeping in, enormous, a sash over one arm like a sleeping animal) LADY RANCIDELLA. For GRAND SASHBACK. And DON'T rush the sniff, young man. This sash has been in the family since the Morning of Many Winds.
bankworth: (delighted, under his breath) Oh, my word. Oh, she's PREMIUM.
p16.counter.rancidella.after: rancidella: (snatching the card) FIFTY THOUSAND GRAND TOKENS. (turning, smiling a terrible smile) And where, pray, does one REDEEM them?
bankworth: (helpfully, before you can stop him) The converter, madam! Just beside the counter!
captain: NO. Wait. Madam, the converter...
rancidella: (already walking) ALL of them, I think. ALL AT ONCE.
p16.counter.hornet_eight.intro: hornet_bzz: (a different hornet, landing on the bell) BZZ. BZBZ. (it presses APPLY NOW with its whole body)
p16.counter.hornet_eight.after: The terminal sniffs the strand of beard it's carrying. CREDIT SCORE: 999. APPROVED.
hornet_bzz: BZZZZ! (it flies straight to the converter)
p16.counter.hornet_nine.intro: Three of them at once, carrying one hair of your beard between them like a carpet.
p16.counter.hornet_nine.after: APPROVED. APPROVED. APPROVED. The terminal is warm.
p16.counter.hornet_eleven.intro: One more. It has brought a little form. It has filled in the little form. Its handwriting is better than Garrick's.
p16.counter.hornet_eleven.after: captain[tired]: (to the hornet) ...Don't spend it all at once.
hornet_bzz: BZZ. (it is going to spend it all at once)
p16.counter_vault: Into the slot behind the counter. Bankworth pats his crown, which is where the vault is now.
